title: Acute Neurological Deficit & Stroke Screening
description: Evidence-based triage for acute focal deficits, transient ischemic attacks, and seizures.

risk_rules.name: Acute Stroke / FAST Positive Pattern
risk_rules.reason: Sudden onset of facial asymmetry, unilateral limb weakness/numbness, or speech slurring/aphasia (FAST positive). Requires immediate time-critical stroke activation.
risk_rules.possible_concern: Acute ischemic stroke or intracranial hemorrhage

risk_rules.name: Active or Prolonged Seizure Activity
risk_rules.reason: Ongoing convulsive activity, post-ictal unresponsiveness, or first-onset seizure with head trauma.
risk_rules.possible_concern: Status epilepticus or acute structural brain injury

risk_rules.name: Transient Ischemic Attack (Resolved Deficit)
risk_rules.reason: Sudden focal neurological deficit that has temporarily resolved. Carries an extremely high short-term risk of completed stroke.

risk_rules.name: Gradual Peripheral Sensory Symptoms
risk_rules.reason: Gradual-onset bilateral stocking-glove numbness, tingling, or tremor without acute focal motor loss or cranial nerve dysfunction.

risk_rules.name: Positional Vertigo without Central Flags
risk_rules.reason: Brief seconds-long spinning sensation triggered exclusively by head movement, with normal gait and absence of diplopia, dysarthria, or weakness.

possible_conditions.name: Acute cerebrovascular accident (Stroke)
possible_conditions.reason_template: Sudden focal loss of function: face droop, unilateral weakness, or slurred speech.
possible_conditions.caveat: Emergency medical services must be contacted immediately. Time-dependent thrombolysis/thrombectomy window applies.

possible_conditions.name: Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA)
possible_conditions.reason_template: Brief episode of neurological dysfunction resolving spontaneously within 24 hours.
possible_conditions.caveat: Requires urgent specialist clinical evaluation, neuroimaging, and carotid evaluation to prevent major stroke.

possible_conditions.name: Peripheral neuropathy
possible_conditions.reason_template: Subacute or chronic symmetric distal numbness/pins-and-needles sensation.
possible_conditions.caveat: Outpatient neurological evaluation recommended for nerve conduction studies.

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Core international FAST stroke screening triage.
recommended_questions.question: Can you smile evenly, raise both arms up in front of you, and repeat a simple sentence clearly?

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Critical metric determining eligibility for time-sensitive thrombolytic or endovascular therapy.
recommended_questions.question: What exact time were you last seen or feeling completely normal?

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Detects posterior circulation stroke and cerebellar compromise.
recommended_questions.question: Are you having sudden double vision, difficulty walking, or severe loss of balance?
